heading: Rules and regulations

tree.heading: Proposed rules and regulations
tree.text: The Secretary shall issue proposed rules and regulations to carry out this part not later than 120 days after June 30, 1980.

tree.heading: Final rules and regulations
tree.text: The Secretary shall issue final rules and regulations to carry out this part not later than 90 days after the issuance of proposed rules and regulations under subsection (a).

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 95–619, title II, § 265, as added Pub. L. 96–294, title V, § 562, June 30, 1980, 94 Stat. 749.)
